from pathlib import Path
program_dir = Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545201/attempts/077c639e3ede471faa305f8b7291dc1f/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_text = '''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    uniform_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    uniform_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    for r in uniform_rows:
        for c in range(w):
            out[r][c] = 2
    for c in uniform_cols:
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''

program_file.write_text(program_text)
